criteria.name: title_clarity
criteria.description: Does the title immediately communicate the book's value to a casual browser?

criteria.name: subtitle_specificity
criteria.description: Does the subtitle name the exact reader and the exact result they'll get?

criteria.name: audience_fit
criteria.description: Is the reader avatar sharp enough to create a clear 'this is for me' reaction?

criteria.name: promise_strength
criteria.description: Is the core promise bold, specific, and believable — not vague or inflated?

criteria.name: market_distinction
criteria.description: Is there a clear, credible reason to choose this over existing books on the topic?

criteria.name: practical_sellability
criteria.description: Can this book be summarised in one sentence a stranger would immediately understand?

criteria.name: kdp_search_visibility
criteria.description: Does the title/subtitle contain language buyers actually search on Amazon?
